movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms used to form bridges and wings; handkerchief held by the leader
movement_profile.partnering: Couples linked by arms or moving in a line

signature_moves.description: Dancers form an arch with their arms for others to pass under.
signature_moves.name: El puente

signature_moves.description: Two lines of dancers create a corridor for other pairs to traverse.
signature_moves.name: Las calles

music_profile.meter: 3/4 in eastern variants; variable in Andean versions
music_profile.musical_form: Simple i-V harmony or minor pentatonic

reference_recordings.artist: Raúl Otero Reiche and Jorge Luna
reference_recordings.title: Palomita de Arrozal

music_profile.sound_description: A blend of high-pitched Andean flutes (quena, siku) and the percussive, rhythmic strumming of the charango, creating a bright and communal atmosphere.
music_profile.vocal_style: Collective singing of verses or improvisations

basic_steps: Passing through a 'street' formed by other dancers
teaching.level_notes: Focus on the communal, playful interaction rather than rigid technique.
teaching.rhythm: Simple, lively, often 3/4 in eastern variants or pentatonic-based in Andean versions.
